create_joint_distribution: create a Joint distribution from a tree of independent distributions like Normal and Categorical
sample_from_joint: sample from a Joint distribution using JAX PRNGKey to get structured samples matching the tree
compute_joint_log_prob: compute the summed log probability of values across all distributions in a Joint distribution
compute_joint_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between two Joint distributions with matching tree structures
index_joint_distribution: index a Joint distribution by batch dimension to select specific batch elements
